manager_rules: When ≥2 FEM over-temp flags target SENSEC*_HI or SENSEC*_LO nets, trigger power-pour expansion on those nets (widen corridor keepout and add B.Cu mirror pour if absent) before accepting the candidate.

When kelvin_unrouted >= 1, increase router optimization passes by 50% for the failing cable's net group and widen the shunt corridor keepout for that cable by 0.5 mm on each lateral side to open a clear egress channel for the Kelvin pair before re-running.

When a via over-temp FEM flag targets any SENSEC* net, reduce the stitch-via pitch in that cable's power-pour via field by 50% (halve the inter-via spacing) before the next route pass, distributing current across more via barrels to lower per-via temperature without enlarging the pour footprint.
